claims.text: November injection barrels start trading October 1, 6 days out. The forward balance for November is +191 kb/d into storage; October was the heavy maintenance month at 164 kb/d offline.
Basis signal is bearish: October preliminary -16.48 vs September final -15.32, a 1.16 widening. November basis is unobservable (no strips supplied); nothing fabricated.
Storage path is roughly flat: the forward balance moves from 58.7 Mbbl toward about 45.1 Mbbl by September 2027. Utilization is not computable on the stale provisional capacity.
Enbridge apportionment 12.4% (June 2026, latest Canada Energy Regulator print) keeps the egress flag on WATCH. PADD 2 (Midwest) refinery runs are normal at +307 kb/d vs seasonal norm.
Data calendar: August ST3 actuals due soon (closes the two-month anchor gap); Q3 earnings in late October refresh the maintenance picture.
